title: 1993-94 Upper Deck Checklist Card #253 - Basketball
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This sports trading card from the 1994 Upper Deck set is a must-have for any basketball fan. Featuring card number 253, it showcases a checklist of the 1993-1994 season for the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card is in near mint or better condition and is perfect for collectors.
The card is not autographed but it still makes for a great addition to any collection. It is manufactured by Upper Deck and features important aspects such as the sport of basketball, the league of NBA, and the season of 1994. This listing is perfect for anyone looking to enhance their collection of trading cards.
